title: Level 1 Functional Documentation Traceability
goal: Classify Level 1 functional elements so public parameter gates are documentation-traceable, purpose and design comments are retained as semantic evidence, and internal control flow is excluded from top-level documentation completeness findings.

branch_refinement.public_parameter_scope: public command and exported module parameters only

public_parameter_gate.acceptance: A documented parameter name is found in the ordered documentation hierarchy.

design_comment_gate.acceptance: Strong nearby comments are retained as semantic evidence and routed for semantic review; literal matching does not claim semantic equivalence.

internal_control_flow.acceptance: Local implementation mechanics are retained for navigation but excluded from top-level documentation completeness findings.
